derivation.behavior: Backend compatibility is exact for the concrete operation.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Each Go backend implements CanExecute(intent) with typed incompatibility reasons matching execution preflight.

invariants: Compatibility is computed from the canonical NetworkIntent plus execution requirements, not from frontend heuristics.
Every hard incompatibility uses one of the typed dimensions: protocol, method_body, destination, credential_mode, proxy, media_shape, resume, mirror_semantics.
Native and aria2 implement the same CanExecute and Preflight contract surface.
A request accepted by CanExecute must pass backend preflight; a rejected request must fail preflight with the same first typed reason.
Soft preference hints never convert an incompatible operation into a compatible one.
